system.description:
Readied Baggage (Passive): All Readied baggage items must be equipped to RIS to work. When occupying RIS, baggage items create extra RIS within them, often with specific requirements.

Bandolier (Large) (Passive): This item provides 6 readied item slots (RIS). You cannot store any individual item over 2 slots in size in these slots. You cannot store weapons, shields, or baggage in these slots.

2 Item Slots · 150gc · Readied Baggage, rulebook p.202
